chunks: The hypocrites (are the same) whether men or women, the one of them being of the other. They encourage what is bad and dissuade from the good, and tighten their purses (when it comes to spending in the way of God). Of God they are oblivious; so He is oblivious of them. The hypocrites are indeed transgressors.
ai.seo_question: What are the main characteristics of the hypocrites mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the internal cohesion of the hypocrites, who mirror each other’s traits of commanding evil and forbidding good, while their 'withholding hands' signifies stinginess in charity and readiness for battle. The phrase 'God forgot them' is understood as a divine retribution where they are deprived of guidance and mercy, culminating in their classification as al-fasiqun (transgressors) who exceed the bounds of faith. This characterization underscores the spiritual decay that results from the disconnect between outward profession and inward reality.
